description: This file defines the LeaveDecorator class in the OrangeHRM project, providing additional behavior and formatting for Leave entities, including setting relations like Employee and LeaveType, and formatting leave status, date, duration, start/end times, and fetching the last comment.

classes.name: LeaveDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Leave entity, providing utility methods for formatting, accessing related entities, and managing leave status and timings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a specific Leave entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee relation of the Leave based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the LeaveType relation of the Leave based on leave type ID.

methods.name: getLeaveStatus
methods.description: Returns the leave status in a human-readable format.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusName
methods.description: Retrieves the leave status name based on the internal status code.

methods.name: getLeaveDate
methods.description: Formats and returns the leave date as a string.

methods.name: getLeaveDuration
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the leave duration type.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted start time if the leave duration requires specific times.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted end time if the leave duration requires specific times.

methods.name: getLastComment
methods.description: Fetches the most recent comment related to the leave.
